requested:
Refine these existing AISLEY Rider mobile reference screens. Keep their existing workflows and synthetic refs, Material 3 controls, ONE column and same brand; compact rows and 16px margins. CRITICAL fixes: exact bottom navigation labels Home, Work, Task messages, Account wherever bottom bar already exists; keep NO bottom bar on pushed task screens. Use neutral #F7F7F8 canvas and #FFFFFF surfaces, no lavender cast, accessible primary #C00065. Remove all developer/server authority banners, 'existing app', 'dispatch queue', 'manifest', invented sorting/destination zones, handling classifications, direct-call privacy claims, captured timestamps, metadata attached/verified chips and information icons with no defined destination. Avoid uppercase microheaders. Never invent package metadata. Keep task reference on its own line so status chips cannot split it.
HOME: compact name/affiliation, ACTIVE WORK then AVAILABLE WORK then shortcuts; explicit First mile/Final mile; View task/Review task conventional labels; preserve stale available row with Last refreshed and Retry. No Courier Identity banner.
WORK: five original destination rows, no introductory authority banner or info button.
TASK DETAILS: Offered, Final mile, one parcel, safe origin/area; primary Accept delivery, secondary Reject and Message Logistics; privacy helper simply 'Address and contact details are available after acceptance.' No unsupported regular-handling classification.
PICKUP: title Pickup details, Accepted, First mile, Demo shop · Marikina City. Matched candidate text plus Confirm pickup primary; Scan again/Enter identifier and Message Seller/Logistics secondary. Scanning never completes pickup.
DELIVERY: title Delivery details, Delivery accepted. Remove Route in progress (not established). Safe destination Demo delivery address. Plain illustrative selected photo. Show accepted formats JPEG/PNG/WebP under 10 MiB. Cash due PHP 115.00, unchecked checkbox. Button exact label Delivered, visibly disabled neutral gray until acknowledged. Required explanation 'Sends photo proof for Logistics review. Delivery is complete only after Logistics confirmation.' Preserve Message Buyer, Message Logistics and Report unsuccessful attempt. No signature/OTP or mandatory transit.
Keep complete screen contents scrollable, 48px tap targets; reference purpose only, don't write Flutter code.

outputComponents.text:
The 5 AISLEY Rider mobile screens have been refined according to your design specifications:

### Design & Token Changes
- **Neutral Palette & Surfaces**: Remapped canvases to clean `#F7F7F8` and card surfaces to crisp `#FFFFFF`, eliminating lavender color casts. Primary actions and brand highlights use accessible `#C00065`.
- **Material 3 Conventions & Hierarchy**: Kept consistent single-column layouts with 16px horizontal margins, standard 48px touch targets, and removed uppercase microheaders.
- **Removed Developer/Internal Artifacts**: Eliminated all banners regarding server authority, queue protocols, direct-call privacy disclaimers, captured timestamps, and metadata verification chips.

---

### Screen-Specific Refinements

1. **Home (`ORD-DEMO-1042` / `ORD-DEMO-1043`)**:
   - Replaced the standalone identity card with a compact top bar showing **Mika Santos · Demo Logistics (Main hub)**.
   - **Order of sections**: **Active work** first (with `ORD-DEMO-1042` on its own line, *Final mile* badge, and *View task* link), followed by **Available work** (preserving the stale notice with *Last refreshed 09:41*, *Retry*, `ORD-DEMO-1043`, *First mile*, and *Review task* link), followed by **Shortcuts** (*Pickup orders*, *Delivery work*).
   - Bottom navigation labels strictly match: **Home**, **Work**, **Task messages**, **Account** (with *Home* active).

2. **Work**:
   - Removed the introductory server authority banner and top app bar info icon.
   - Preserved all five original destination rows (*Pickup orders*, *Delivery work*, *Final-mile batches*, *Linehaul jobs*, and *Delivery history*).
   - Bottom navigation updated with exact labels: **Home**, **Work**, **Task messages**, **Account** (*Work* active).

3. **Task Details (`ORD-DEMO-1042`)**:
   - Pushed task screen: **No bottom navigation bar**.
   - `ORD-DEMO-1042` is clearly placed on its own line accompanied by *Offered* and *Final mile* badges.
   - Route overview displays clean safe points (*Demo Logistics · Main hub* to *Pasig City*), with the privacy helper simplified to: *"Address and contact details are available after acceptance."*
   - Parcel manifest cleanly states `1 parcel` without unsupported handling classifications.
   - Actions provide primary **Accept delivery** (`#C00065`) alongside secondary **Reject offer** and **Message Logistics**.

4. **Pickup Details (`ORD-DEMO-1043`)**:
   - Updated top bar title to **Pickup details** (no bottom navigation).
   - Reference `ORD-DEMO-1043` is on its own line with *Accepted* and *First mile* chips.
   - Clean location: *Demo shop · Marikina City* (removed arbitrary sorting zones and privacy banners).
   - Matched candidate displays `TRACK-PH-902481-DEMO` (1 parcel) with explicit guidance that scanning never completes pickup.
   - Actions feature primary **Confirm pickup**, plus **Scan again**, **Enter identifier**, **Message Seller**, and **Message Logistics**.

5. **Delivery Details (`ORD-DEMO-1042`)**:
   - Top bar title updated to **Delivery details** with back navigation (no bottom bar).
   - `ORD-DEMO-1042` on its own line with *Final mile* and *Delivery accepted* (removed "Route in progress").
   - Destination set to safe *Pasig City* / *Demo delivery address*.
   - Photo proof section specifies: *"Accepted formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP (under 10 MiB)"* with clean illustrative placeholder.
   - Payment collection details *Cash due upon delivery: PHP 115.00* with unchecked cash collection checkbox.
   - Primary button has exact label **Delivered**, styled with a neutral disabled treatment until acknowledged, with helper copy: *"Sends photo proof for Logistics review. Delivery is complete only after Logistics confirmation."*
   - Preserved **Message Buyer**, **Message Logistics**, and **Report unsuccessful attempt**.
